name: Multiclassified Structure Graph Construction
definition: A directed graph G = (I, E) representing the structural relationships of a multiclassified voxel model V. Nodes I are class identifiers from nc independent classification criteria. Edges E represent implication relationships where one isoclass includes another.
summary: Multiclassified Structure Graph Construction builds a directed acyclic graph of inclusion relationships between isoclasses, enabling visualization of complex semantic hierarchies where voxels belong to multiple classes simultaneously.
